title: Tatooine Repulsor Train
text:
This unit can't be attacked while you control 2 or more exhausted units (unless it gains Sentinel).
On Attack: Deal 2 damage to a ground unit for each friendly exhausted unit.
rules:
(ERRATA) On Attack: Choose a ground unit. Deal 2 damage to it for each friendly exhausted unit.
If Tatooine Repulsor Train gains Sentinel, it can be attacked, even while you control 2 or more exhausted units.
